import ctypes

# Load libraries with proper order and mode
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define GSL permutation structure
class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]

def permutation_inverse(input_perm):
    size = len(input_perm)
    
    # Allocate memory for input permutation
    p = gsl_permutation()
    p.size = size
    p.data = (ctypes.c_size_t * size)(*input_perm)
    
    # Allocate memory for inverse permutation
    inv = gsl_permutation()
    inv.size = size
    inv.data = (ctypes.c_size_t * size)()
    
    # Call the inverse function
    result = gsl.gsl_permutation_inverse(ctypes.byref(inv), ctypes.byref(p))
    
    if result != 0:  # GSL_SUCCESS = 0
        raise RuntimeError(f"gsl_permutation_inverse failed with error code: {result}")
    
    # Convert result to Python list
    return [inv.data[i] for i in range(size)]

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Simple permutation
    perm1 = [2, 0, 1]
    expected1 = [1, 2, 0]
    result1 = permutation_inverse(perm1)
    assert result1 == expected1, f"Expected {expected1}, got {result1}"
    
    # Test case 2: Identity permutation
    perm2 = [0, 1, 2, 3]
    expected2 = [0, 1, 2, 3]
    result2 = permutation_inverse(perm2)
    assert result2 == expected2, f"Expected {expected2}, got {result2}"
    
    # Test case 3: Larger permutation
    perm3 = [3, 0, 2, 1, 4]
    expected3 = [1, 3, 2, 0, 4]
    result3 = permutation_inverse(perm3)
    assert result3 == expected3, f"Expected {expected3}, got {result3}"
    
    # Test case 4: Empty permutation (edge case)
    perm4 = []
    expected4 = []
    result4 = permutation_inverse(perm4)
    assert result4 == expected4, f"Expected {expected4}, got {result4}"
    
    # Test case 5: Single element
    perm5 = [0]
    expected5 = [0]
    result5 = permutation_inverse(perm5)
    assert result5 == expected5, f"Expected {expected5}, got {result5}"
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
